paragraphs.text: Processor is a creature type exclusive to Eldrazi and is associated with Ulamog 's brood. It was introduced alongside Scion in Battle for Zendikar .

Processors are both a mechanical marker type and effectively a class for Eldrazi. All Processors have an ability that requires you to put your opponent's exiled cards into their graveyard for some effect . Of the eleven creatures, eight use one exiled card at a time and three use two. Battle for Zendikar uses Ingesting creatures to fuel these Processors, alongside a collection of exiling interactive spells. The mechanic is largely in blue-black, with one green card. Processor Assault is a related sorcery that uses the same mechanical cost, and is the only processing ability in red. During design, this mechanic was known as "digest" or "process".

The mechanical implementation of Processing was difficult primarily because finding effects that fit the narrow requirements of the mechanic were tricky. Compounding this was the need for additional exile support within a Limited or Standard environment. With such strong ties to the Processor creature type, and flavor ties to Ulamog, Mark believes it unlikely for Processor to return.
